caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light-beige background. The object is a column or pedestal structure rendered in shades of light tan, beige, and soft pink. The base consists of two stacked rectangular platforms, each with beveled edges. Above this base, the column features a rounded, fluted shaft with vertical grooves, which is topped by a ringed, circular section. The capital of the column is ornate, with several bulbous, rounded projections arranged in a symmetrical pattern, resembling stylized lotus buds or petals. The shading suggests a smooth, stone-like texture and gives the column a three-dimensional appearance. There are no additional objects or decorative features in the composition, and the background remains empty.
title: Candlestick
